variables.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: Username used to sign in to the Cleaver admin portal.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password used to sign in to the Cleaver admin portal.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Secret value used to sign admin session cookies; use a long, randomly generated value.

variables.name: DB_PATH
variables.description: SQLite database path, resolved relative to config/.env when not absolute; defaults to ../data/main.sqlite.
